newsitem.title: USA: Apple CFO says to launch Powerbook models.
newsitem.headline: Apple CFO says to launch Powerbook models.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc Chief Financial Officer Fred Anderson said the company will launch a new low-end PowerBook model by the end of this month and a high-end PowerBook in the first calendar 1997 quarter.

Anderson told analysts, however, that due to the product transition, sales of PowerBooks would fall $150 million sequentially in the first fiscal quarter from its fourth fiscal quarter, and overall revenues would be roughly flat.
"Revenue will not show sequential gains because of lower portable sales," he said.
